list.name: snapshot_max_age
list.label: Freshness budget (seconds)
list.description: Numeric seconds: schedule interval plus maximum acceptable run time and collection delay.

panels.title: Scheduled work · health, progress, and failure context

options.content:
**Read the latest published invocation.** Collector availability, snapshot freshness, and worker success answer different questions. A fresh file may describe a failed run; a reachable collector may expose an old file.

Every work count below belongs to the **last published run**, even though the metric is named `_total`. History repeats the most recently observed snapshot between runs; it is not a count of invocations. The freshness budget is **${snapshot_max_age}s**. Unknown stays unknown.

panels.title: Collectors reachable
panels.description: Availability of selected node-exporter endpoints, not worker success. No discovered targets produces Unknown.

panels.title: Fresh snapshots
panels.description: Count of reachable collectors with snapshot age within the selected budget. Fresh does not imply success.

targets.expr: sum(((((time() - max by (deployment,instance) (fleet_recall_snapshot_time_seconds{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}) > bool ${snapshot_max_age:raw}) and on (deployment,instance) (max by (deployment,instance) (up{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}) == 1)) or on (deployment,instance) (0 * (max by (deployment,instance) (up{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}) == 1) + 2) or on (deployment,instance) (0 * (max by (deployment,instance) (up{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}) == 0) + 3)) == 0) * 0 + 1) or sum(0 * max by (deployment,instance) (up{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}))

panels.title: Stale snapshots
panels.description: Reachable collectors whose snapshot age exceeds the budget. Inspect scheduling and export failures.

targets.expr: sum(((((time() - max by (deployment,instance) (fleet_recall_snapshot_time_seconds{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}) > bool ${snapshot_max_age:raw}) and on (deployment,instance) (max by (deployment,instance) (up{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}) == 1)) or on (deployment,instance) (0 * (max by (deployment,instance) (up{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}) == 1) + 2) or on (deployment,instance) (0 * (max by (deployment,instance) (up{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}) == 0) + 3)) == 1) * 0 + 1) or sum(0 * max by (deployment,instance) (up{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}))

panels.title: Missing snapshots
panels.description: Reachable collectors with no Fleet snapshot. A down collector is tracked separately and remains unknown.

targets.expr: sum(((((time() - max by (deployment,instance) (fleet_recall_snapshot_time_seconds{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}) > bool ${snapshot_max_age:raw}) and on (deployment,instance) (max by (deployment,instance) (up{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}) == 1)) or on (deployment,instance) (0 * (max by (deployment,instance) (up{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}) == 1) + 2) or on (deployment,instance) (0 * (max by (deployment,instance) (up{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}) == 0) + 3)) == 2) * 0 + 1) or sum(0 * max by (deployment,instance) (up{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}))

panels.title: Failed latest runs
panels.description: Count of failed latest process/worker observations among reachable collectors. No known run outcomes yields Unknown, not zero.

targets.expr: sum(((max by (deployment,instance) (fleet_recall_operations_total{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance",component="process",operation="worker",outcome="error"} or (0 * fleet_recall_operations_total{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance",component="process",operation="worker",outcome="success"}))) and on (deployment,instance) (max by (deployment,instance) (up{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}) == 1)) > bool 0)

panels.title: Unknown latest runs
panels.description: Selected collectors that are down or have no terminal process/worker outcome. Includes snapshots written by another command.

targets.expr: sum(((((max by (deployment,instance) (fleet_recall_operations_total{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance",component="process",operation="worker",outcome="error"} or (0 * fleet_recall_operations_total{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance",component="process",operation="worker",outcome="success"}))) and on (deployment,instance) (max by (deployment,instance) (up{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}) == 1)) or on (deployment,instance) (0 * max by (deployment,instance) (up{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}) + 2)) == 2) * 0 + 1) or sum(0 * max by (deployment,instance) (up{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}))

panels.title: Snapshot state by instance
panels.description: Fresh/stale use the snapshot timestamp and budget. Missing requires an up collector with no snapshot; down collectors remain distinct.

targets.expr: ((time() - max by (deployment,instance) (fleet_recall_snapshot_time_seconds{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}) > bool ${snapshot_max_age:raw}) and on (deployment,instance) (max by (deployment,instance) (up{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}) == 1)) or on (deployment,instance) (0 * (max by (deployment,instance) (up{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}) == 1) + 2) or on (deployment,instance) (0 * (max by (deployment,instance) (up{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}) == 0) + 3)

panels.title: Latest worker outcome by instance
panels.description: Derived directly from process/worker success or error, preserving deployment labels. Unknown is explicit for missing terminal worker observations and collector outages. A succeeded run may still be stale: compare the snapshot state.

targets.expr: ((max by (deployment,instance) (fleet_recall_operations_total{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance",component="process",operation="worker",outcome="error"} or (0 * fleet_recall_operations_total{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance",component="process",operation="worker",outcome="success"}))) and on (deployment,instance) (max by (deployment,instance) (up{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}) == 1)) or on (deployment,instance) (0 * max by (deployment,instance) (up{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}) + 2)

panels.title: Snapshot age
panels.description: Age since atomic snapshot publication. Clock skew may produce negative age. Budget line is shown only when a snapshot exists.

panels.title: Snapshot state history
panels.description: Collector state and snapshot age at each query step. This makes a stale successful run and an unreachable collector visibly different. Missing intervals are not connected.

targets.expr: ((time() - max by (deployment,instance) (fleet_recall_snapshot_time_seconds{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}) > bool ${snapshot_max_age:raw}) and on (deployment,instance) (max by (deployment,instance) (up{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}) == 1)) or on (deployment,instance) (0 * (max by (deployment,instance) (up{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}) == 1) + 2) or on (deployment,instance) (0 * (max by (deployment,instance) (up{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}) == 0) + 3)

panels.title: Latest-run outcome history
panels.description: The last observed run state persists until a new snapshot is published. This is an observation timeline, not an event log, run counter, or duration of the worker process.

targets.expr: ((max by (deployment,instance) (fleet_recall_operations_total{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance",component="process",operation="worker",outcome="error"} or (0 * fleet_recall_operations_total{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance",component="process",operation="worker",outcome="success"}))) and on (deployment,instance) (max by (deployment,instance) (up{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}) == 1)) or on (deployment,instance) (0 * max by (deployment,instance) (up{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance"}) + 2)

panels.title: 02 · Where the latest invocation spent time
Step duration · latest run
panels.description: Direct histogram sum/count within one process, by step and instance. Normally one completed execution per selected step. Unselected/skipped steps are excluded; failures still contribute elapsed time.

targets.expr: sum by (deployment,instance,operation) (fleet_recall_operation_duration_seconds_sum{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance",component="worker_step",operation=~"transcript|git|ci|collect|bodies|lexical|dense"}) / sum by (deployment,instance,operation) (fleet_recall_operation_duration_seconds_count{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance",component="worker_step",operation=~"transcript|git|ci|collect|bodies|lexical|dense"}) and on (deployment,instance,operation) (sum by (deployment,instance,operation) (fleet_recall_operations_total{job="fleet-worker-textfile",deployment=~"$deployment",instance=~"$worker_instance",component="worker_step",outcome!="skipped"}) > 0)

panels.title: Command and tick duration · observed snapshots
panels.description: Per-invocation mean duration from direct histogram sum/count. Command includes configuration and report writing; tick covers the work. Nested durations must not be added together.

panels.title: 03 · Work in the last published invocation
Admitted and replayed events
panels.description: Each bar is a step counter in the latest snapshot. Appended and replayed are separate categories; source-level counts are deliberately excluded to avoid double counting.

panels.title: Admission work requiring attention
panels.description: Separate counts for quarantined, dead-lettered, held, and retry-exhausted work in the latest step report. Categories can describe different handling stages; do not sum them into a failure total.

panels.title: Evidence events projected
panels.description: Body-plane event counts from the latest invocation. Unprojectable occurrences can be expected for occurrence-form observer records; consult the worker report before treating them as errors.

panels.title: Recall index rows
panels.description: Rows processed by lexical and dense steps in the latest invocation. Reprojected rows can overlap rows indexed, so these are separate measures, not additive categories.

panels.title: Transcript bytes consumed
panels.description: Bytes read by the transcript step in the latest invocation. Kept separate from item/event counters. No series means no reported byte counter, not proof of zero activity.

panels.title: 04 · Source outcomes, retry pressure, and details
Sources checked · latest outcome
panels.description: Per-source outcomes aggregated by the four code-owned source kinds, by instance. Counts refer to sources checked in the latest run, not source identities or the number of accepted events.

panels.title: Database attempts and retries · latest run
panels.description: Direct counts from the shared transaction helper in the worker process. Attempts includes the first attempt; retry counters are subsets, not additive to attempts. Missing retry series means not observed. No rate or rolling sum is applied.

panels.title: Collector items · latest provider pass
panels.description: Counts from the collector provider pass, separate from the step outbox drain. Audience-refused can overlap refused; compare categories without stacking or summing them.

panels.title: Step completion detail
panels.description: One row per reported step/outcome from the latest process. Skipped is explicit. Failure details and source identities remain in the protected worker stdout report.

options.content:
**Collector down / missing snapshot:** inspect node exporter, its private scrape route, the textfile directory, file readability, and scheduler. Snapshots are written with Unix mode `0600`; use one Fleet snapshot identity per collector endpoint.

**Stale snapshot:** inspect job scheduling, overlapping workers, termination, clock agreement, and `telemetry.export.failed` events. A prior healthy snapshot can survive a crashed process or failed export.

**Failed run:** inspect the protected stdout tick report and `operation.completed` JSON events for the same instance/time. Read the failing step and source outcomes before retrying. Source text and identifiers never become telemetry labels.

**Interpretation:** every count and duration is one latest invocation. Never sum samples over calendar time to infer annual work, never apply a counter rate to these snapshots, and never combine step totals with source totals. Missing data is not healthy zero.
